# Commits deliberately not backported, so the report stops flagging them.
#
# Format, one per line:
#   <subject>                  ignore for every target branch
#   <target-branch>::<subject> ignore for one target branch only
#
# Subjects are matched exactly, so paste the commit title verbatim.
# Blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored.

# 4.2.x has no init_mysql_db/init_pgsql_db, so these cannot apply there.
release/4.2.x::fix(docker): pass MySQL password via defaults file instead of command line (refs #1318)
release/4.2.x::fix(docker): build psql port argument as an array
release/4.2.x::fix(docker): optionally initialize PowerDNS schema for empty MySQL/PostgreSQL databases
release/4.2.x::fix(docker): initialize MySQL/PostgreSQL schema on fresh container start (closes #1307)

# These fix the SSO env var mapping feature, which 4.2.x does not ship. One also
# edits the 4.3.0 migration files, which do not exist on 4.2.x.
release/4.2.x::fix(auth): safer SSO template revocation and backward-compatible env var parsing
release/4.2.x::fix(auth): address review feedback for SSO template management

# 4.2.x never had the api.log_requests setting, so there is nothing to remove.
release/4.2.x::fix(docker): remove dead api.log_requests config from entrypoint

# The 4.2.x/4.3.x entrypoints do not generate favicon_path/logo_path at all,
# so there is nothing to escape.
release/4.3.x::fix(docker): escape the favicon and logo paths when generating config
release/4.2.x::fix(docker): escape the favicon and logo paths when generating config

# PA_DNS_DEFAULT_ZONE_TEMPLATE arrived with the 4.4.0 default zone template, so
# the 4.2.x/4.3.x entrypoints never generate that setting.
release/4.3.x::fix(docker): escape the default zone template name when generating config
release/4.2.x::fix(docker): escape the default zone template name when generating config

# The 4.6.0 Docker hardening (none is a security or data-loss fix). No release line takes it:
# 4.5.x keeps the 4.5.0 image and the older lines keep theirs.
fix(docker): split trusted proxies on whitespace too and detect PEM secrets with leading headers
fix(docker): own /app and the template cache directory so non-root containers can cache templates
fix(docker): escape group and template mappings like every other setting and honour yes/1 for PA_CREATE_ADMIN in the summary
fix(docker): accept the CA certificate from a secret file and escape the proxy list for sed
fix(docker): probe /ping in the healthcheck when the liveness endpoint is enabled
fix(docker): answer CORS preflight only under /api with a configurable origin and tier the cache lifetimes
fix(docker): keep group 0 on the volumes the entrypoint re-owns
fix(docker): wait for the database before schema init and honour DB_PORT when creating the admin user
fix(docker): escape every string and validate every number written to settings.php
fix(docker): keep the generated settings.php readable by www-data only
fix(docker): deny dotfiles, shell scripts and translation sources in the Caddy configs
fix(docker): run PHP on php.ini-production with tuned limits and opcache
fix(docker): load the image's php overrides first so mounted ini files win
fix(docker): keep SQLite WAL sidecar files out of the web root

# The health endpoint arrived in 4.5.0, so 4.2.x-4.4.x have no cache file to guard.
# 4.5.x took the fix folded into its health cache backport.
release/4.5.x::fix(api): ignore a symlinked health cache file and document the token header for container healthchecks
release/4.4.x::fix(api): ignore a symlinked health cache file and document the token header for container healthchecks
release/4.3.x::fix(api): ignore a symlinked health cache file and document the token header for container healthchecks
release/4.2.x::fix(api): ignore a symlinked health cache file and document the token header for container healthchecks

# The database wait went to master and 4.4.x only; 4.2.x/4.3.x keep their entrypoints.
release/4.3.x::fix(docker): wait for the database before schema init
release/4.2.x::fix(docker): wait for the database before schema init

# The bug exists on 4.2.x too, but 4.2.x is winding down (end of life 2027-01-31) and takes fixes on request only.
release/4.2.x::fix(docker): pass DB_PORT to the admin user step of the entrypoint (closes #1653)

# 4.4.x took the escape inside its 4.4.0 environment variables commit.
release/4.4.x::fix(docker): escape the default zone template name when generating config
